column2: A modal double-faced card can't be transformed or be put onto the battlefield transformed.
column3: Outdated: written 2020–2024 under the CR that limited transforming to transforming double-faced cards and tokens (701.27a, 712.9; glossary: modal double-faced cards “can’t transform”; still so in the CR effective 2025-07-25). The Comprehensive Rules update effective 2025-09-19 (Marvel's Spider-Man) let modal double-faced cards transform and be put onto the battlefield transformed (701.27a, 712.3, 712.9, 712.14a); Wizards' 2025-09-19 ruling (Peter Parker et al.): “A modal double-faced card can be transformed or be put onto the battlefield transformed. This is a change from previous rules.” That ruling is cited in tests/rulings/r_s17_transform_modal.rs
